meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你在 cmem.ai 拿到的三项凭据(同步令牌、用户 id、SyncHub URL)写进插件配置,让 hooks 能捕获并注入记忆。令牌只经文件读写搬运,不会回显在对话或命令行里。
howto.when: 当你要求 set up claude-mem、连接 cmem,或直接粘贴 cmem.ai Connect 里的凭据值时,它接管这次配置。

say.text: 帮我配置 claude-mem,这是我的 cmem 同步令牌
say.note: 它会写入插件 config.json 并校验状态

say.text: 把这三个 cmem Connect 值写进插件配置
say.note: 有缺失时会先向你要同步令牌

say.text: 检查一下 cmem 配对状态
say.note: 运行 status 并返回打码后的输出

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes your three cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into the plugin config so hooks can capture and inject memory. The token moves only via file reads and writes, never echoed in chat or shell argv.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up claude-mem, pair claude-mem or connect cmem, or when you paste cmem.ai Connect values for this plugin.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my cmem sync token
say_en.note: Writes the plugin config.json and verifies status

say_en.text: Add these three cmem Connect values to the plugin config
say_en.note: Asks for the sync token if any are missing
Runs status and reports masked output
